title: Checkpoint: Resilient Fetch Pipeline
prompt:
Implement the pipeline described in the checkpoint:

```csharp
static Task<List<string>> FetchAll(IEnumerable<string> keys, TimeSpan perCall, CancellationToken ct);
static string Report(List<string> results);   // "a=ok|b=timeout" sorted by key
```

tests.name: fan-out with per-call timeout
tests.hint: Start all CjFlaky.FetchAsync tasks; await each with task.WaitAsync(perCall, ct) catching TimeoutException -> record "key=timeout".

tests.name: caller cancel aborts
tests.hint: ct.ThrowIfCancellationRequested() before the fan-out AND pass ct to each WaitAsync — cancel lands promptly.

tests.name: report sorted by key
tests.code:
var results = new System.Collections.Generic.List<string> { "b=timeout", "a=ok", "c=ok" };
Cj.Eq(Solution.Report(results), "a=ok|b=timeout|c=ok", "sorted join");
